name: Beam Border Card
description: A feature card blurs in over a dot grid while a light beam races around its border at constant speed, trailing a gradient tail and lighting the card surface beneath it.
move: A feature card blurs in over a dot grid while a light beam races around its border at constant speed, trailing a gradient tail and lighting the card surface beneath it.
how: One rounded-rect path, three dashes (tail, blurred glow, bright head) placed by stroke-dashoffset so speed is constant on edges and corners. Beam distance tweens 1.75 laps with power1.inOut. A radial highlight inside the card follows getPointAtLength of the head.
adapt: Resize the card and the SVG rect together; change the gradient stops for brand colours. Placeholder product names and copy are generic. Colours come from the palette tokens at the top of the page (--bg, --surface, --ink, --muted, --accent, --accent-2); change those to re-brand it.
port: Timeline-driven: register the page's CustomEase curves, scope selectors to the shot and rebuild the timeline; state painted in onUpdate must stay a function of tl.time().
caveats: Original implementation; no third-party UI kit, product or brand assets.
Starts and ends on its opening frame so it loops; trim the exit when cutting to the next shot.
